tool.name: florida_new_filings_search
tool.title: Florida Sunbiz Business Entity Search
tool.description:
Search the Florida Division of Corporations (Sunbiz) business registry by company name, returning entity name, document number, status, and entity type.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/fl-sos-new-filings'.
- Side Effects: Reads public sources and creates a billed Actor run and dataset on your Apify account.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typical run duration is 10-30 seconds without detail pages, longer with include_details enabled; timeout capped at 120 seconds.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for Florida LLC/corporation lookup by company name, due-diligence checks, or monitoring new Florida business filings.
- When NOT to use: Do not use to search by a person's or officer's name (use 'florida_officer_search' instead), for other states, or for contractor licences.
- Named alternatives: Use 'florida_officer_search' to find companies tied to a person or registered agent, 'us_business_entity_search' for a multi-state lookup that includes Florida, or 'alabama_business_search' for Alabama-only records.

search_query.description: Full or partial Florida business name to search on Sunbiz (e.g. 'SMITH' or 'Smith Services LLC').

max_results.description: Maximum number of entity records to return and bill. Defaults to 10.

include_details.description: When true, opens each result's Sunbiz detail page to add date filed, FEI/EIN, registered agent, principal/mailing addresses, officers, and annual-report history. Slower; leave off for a fast name-and-status lookup.

entity_name.title: Entity name
entity_name.description: Legal entity name displayed in the Sunbiz result.

document_number.title: Document number
document_number.description: Florida Division of Corporations document number.

status.title: Entity status
status.description: Entity status displayed in the Sunbiz result.

entity_type.title: Entity type
entity_type.description: Florida registry classification, such as a domestic or foreign profit corporation or limited liability company.

date_filed.title: Date filed
date_filed.description: Date the entity was filed with the Florida Division of Corporations.

fei_ein.title: FEI/EIN number
fei_ein.description: Federal employer identification number on file with the state, where one is recorded.

registered_agent.title: Registered agent
registered_agent.description: Name of the entity's Florida registered agent. Null when the state records no agent.

principal_address.title: Principal address
principal_address.description: Principal place of business on file with the state.

search_query.note: The Actor takes start_urls (an array of Sunbiz result-page URLs), not a bare search term. URL-encode search_query (e.g. urllib.parse.quote), substitute it into 'https://search.sunbiz.org/Inquiry/CorporationSearch/SearchResults?inquiryType=EntityName&searchTerm={value}', and wrap the single resulting URL string in a one-element list before assigning to start_urls.

verification.note: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/captainhandsome~fl-sos-new-filings/runs?build=latest&timeout=120 with {"start_urls":["https://search.sunbiz.org/Inquiry/CorporationSearch/SearchResults?inquiryType=EntityName&searchTerm=SMITH"],"max_items":3}; polled to SUCCEEDED; fetched 3 dataset items, all with entity_name containing 'smith' (e.g. 'smith company, inc.', 'smith & co, inc.').
